title: CLI/Script P0 Mutation Gate Implementation v1

scripts_gated.changes: Added --execute flag (default False, dry-run by default), --json flag, governance pre-flight on register/grant/revoke commands via require_governed_execution()
Added --execute flag (default False), --json flag, governance pre-flight on start/stop/restart via require_governed_execution()
Added governance pre-flight before live mutation when triple-flag gate passes. Existing --execute-remote-mutation, --i-understand-this-creates-a-real-pr, --allow-live-writes flags preserved.
Added governance pre-flight before --execute-remote mutation. Existing --dry-run (default True) preserved.
Added --json flag for structured JSON output. No governance gating needed — inherently no_live_network/no_remote_mutation.

helper_functions.purpose: Returns GateDecision. If execute_requested=False, returns ALLOWED without evaluation. If execute_requested=True, evaluates via GovernanceEngine.evaluate_action_legality(). Sets surface=cli_script on the decision.

Returns content-light structured JSON dict with schema_version, script, surface, authority_tier, capability_id, dry_run, execute_requested, decision_id, decision, status, content_light, generated_at. Optional artifacts and error fields.

evidence_persistence.current: GateDecision is returned but not persisted to ReceiptStore. GovernanceRuntime._persist_governance_decision() exists but requires evidence backend wired.
evidence_persistence.seam: CLI governance guard returns structured result as JSON to stdout. Durable evidence persistence is deferred to Governance Decisions as Evidence v1 follow-up.

script_contract_tests_deferred: Subprocess/integration tests that invoke scripts with --execute and verify behavior — deferred to Phase 1 (measurement harness + script hardening follow-up). Too heavyweight for this P0 gate implementation slice.
Real GitHub boundary integration tests — require live GitHub auth, deferred to GitHub Trust Spine implementation.
